questions.prompt: Which is the safest default for practising links, inodes, and file identity?

questions.explanation: For Links, Inodes, and File Identity, use a controlled lab, change one factor at a time, and record the exact result. Some operations in this area can affect data, availability, or access if performed on a real system.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach after a change or observation related to links, inodes, and file identity?
options: Hide the error output and record only the final screen.
Reproduce the observation, test one boundary or failure case, compare expected and actual results, and document the relevant version or distribution.

questions.answer_key: Reproduce the observation, test one boundary or failure case, compare expected and actual results, and document the relevant version or distribution.
